verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect: the docs say the AI agent can "analyze performance" and "report on how your messages perform," it can run scheduled broadcast recaps and deliverability reports, and automations include a Goals component that implies conversion tracking. Nothing documents a native analytics view of the named metrics per campaign or per step. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of opens/clicks/unsubscribes/conversions metrics, per-automation-step reporting, time-series/over-time views, a native reporting UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
